fluidAdditions.description: Keys Neko-TOP reads under `case.fluid`, added to Neko's open `fluid` object.

freeze_flow.description: Freeze the flow at every design iteration. Default false. Read by the topology optimisation drivers; Neko's own `freeze` has no effect there (sources/neko_ext/neko_ext.f90:267).

fluidOptimizing.description: Restrictions on `case.fluid` of a case with an `optimization` object.

scheme.$comment: adjoint_fluid_fctry.f90:56-60 knows only the Pn/Pn scheme (adjoint_case.f90:133).

full_stress_formulation.$comment: adjoint_fluid_pnpn.f90:316-318 aborts when it is true.

cyclic.$comment: adjoint_curl_curl.f90:136-139 aborts when it is true.

items.$comment: adjoint_curl_curl.f90:128-134 aborts for a symmetry velocity condition, plain or in a split item.

pressure_solver.$comment: adjoint_fluid_pnpn.f90:411-422 reads the adjoint pressure solver's absolute_tolerance and max_iterations from here, without a constants lookup. projection_space_size and projection_hold_steps are read from here only when case.adjoint_fluid.pressure_solver has no such key (adjoint_fluid_scheme_incompressible.f90:215-229), which $defs/optimizing in the case-file schema expresses.

svv.$comment: neko src/fluid/fluid_scheme_incompressible.f90:362-380 reads svv.enabled and fluid_pnpn.f90:590-604 builds the SVV Helmholtz operator (full_svv / standard_svv); the adjoint never reads `svv` and always allocates the `standard` operator (adjoint_fluid_pnpn.f90:329), so the adjoint is not the transpose of the forward operator and the sensitivities are inconsistent, with no abort. Same as the scalar (scalar.schema.json, scalarOptimizing).

source_terms.description: Source terms of the forward momentum equation. The state-dependent Neko types `brinkman`, `coriolis`, `boussinesq`, `sponge`, `translation`, `gradient_jump_penalty` and `hpfrt` are not accepted: the adjoint has no counterpart for them, so the sensitivities are wrong with no abort. `constant`, `field`, `centrifugal` and `user` do not depend on the flow and are accepted.
source_terms.$comment: neko src/fluid/fluid_scheme_incompressible.f90:359 builds them for the forward run; the adjoint builds only case.adjoint_fluid.source_term (adjoint_fluid_scheme_incompressible.f90:368-370) and the scalar-convection coupling term (adjoint_case.f90:237); no Neko-TOP source supplies the transposed terms (-chi u_adj, Coriolis, sponge relaxation, buoyancy coupling).

fluidOptimizing.$comment: `nut_field` (adjoint_fluid_pnpn.f90:338-342) and `flow_rate_force` (adjoint_fluid_scheme_incompressible.f90:242-243) abort when present; `Re`, `mu` and `rho` are read as JSON reals without a constants lookup when there is no user material_properties routine (adjoint_fluid_scheme_incompressible.f90:700-729). A case with such a routine and a constants name for them would be accepted by the code, which a case file cannot show.
